pages.ocr_full_text: NSSTA (e-file 80529) File No: Y-11011/1/2022-23NNSSTA-Part Government of India Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation National Statistical Systems Training Academy Plot No. 22, Knowledge Park-II Greater Noida, UP-201310 Date: 22.09.2026 OFFICE MEMORANDUM Subject: Annual Capacity Building Plan (ACBP) for the Officers/Officials of MoSPI for the year 2026-27 reg: This is in reference to DO No. CEOfKarmayogi/2026/1409-1 dated 14t September; 2026 from CEO Karmayogi Bharat; Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) whereby Ministries Departments have been advised to review and upgrade their existing capacity-building frameworks through the AI-enabled Capacity Building Planning (AI-CBP) Tool developed by Karmayogi Bharat 2_ In pursuance of the above; a comprehensive designation-wise Annual Capacity Building Plan (ACBP) for the Officers/Officials of Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation for 2026-27 has been prepared, incorporating/covering Functional, Behavioural and Domain-specific learning courses; identified in accordance with the roles, responsibilities and competency requirements of the concerned Officers/Officials (ACBP enclosed at Annexure-D) 3 Accordingly, all Officers/Officials of MoSPI are requested to undertake the courses as per the designation from the approved ACBP enclosed at Annexure-I in the FY 2026-27. It is also requested to complete atleast one hour of learning o the iGOT Karmayogi portal every month; in line with objective Of continuous learning and capacity building; 4. It is also advised to ensure that their iGOT Karmayogi profile remains updated, particularly with regard to their current designation, organisation and other relevant details, s0 that the courses assigned through the ACBP are appropriately mapped. In case of any query o difficulty relating to registration profile updation Or courses, the concerned iGOT Nodal Officer of the respective division/unit may be contacted (Details of nodal officers is placed at Annexure II) 5. The progress of completion of the courses may be regularly monitored by the concerned Nodal officers/Divisional Heads of respective Divisions Dse Encl: As Above Auqa Kumar Skukla (Suraj Dy. Director To: 1 . All Officerslofficials of MoSPI 2. All iGOT Nodal Officers of MoSPI Copy for_kind information: 1. PPS to Secretary, MoSPI 2. Sr. PPS to Pr: DG (FOD) 3 . PSO to DG(DGYDG(NSSYDG(CS) 4.
